{{Quote|I don't need to ask how you find me. You see, I am your fantasy. I am your experience. So experience me. I am your pleasure. So enjoy me. This is our moment together in time. And we might turn this moment into an eternity.|Mermeia, to Attichitcuk|audio=MermeiaExperience-SWHS.flac|<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
A '''mind evaporator''', also known as a '''proton chair''', was a device used to stimulate the mind. It could be used for either serious or entertainment purposes.

==Characteristics==
"Mind evaporator" was a [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] [[Language/Legends|translation]] of a [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Wookiee term]] for any addictive video game that lacked any form of educational purpose.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I know you're searching for me. Searching, searching. I am here. My voice is for you alone. I am found in your eyes only. I exist for you. I am in your mind as you create me. Oh, yes&hellip; I can feel my creation.''" [giggles] "''I'm getting your message. Are you getting mine?|Mermeia|audio=MermeiaCreation-SWHS.flac|<ref name="Holiday Special" />}}
Attichitcuk also used the device as entertainment.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Leland Holiday">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> he viewed holograms of [[Human/Legends|Human]] females singing and dancing on the machine. One such individual in this [[virtual reality]] he viewed was [[Mermeia]].<ref name="Holiday Special" /> Around the same time, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] bought a proton chair during the Wookiee [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] and brought it home, after which they used it to listen to a sensual female voice speak to them.<ref name="SWG:PC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Proton Chair}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Joe Johnston]] made a conceptual sketch of the mind evaporator, then named the "environmental transporter"&mdash;a virtual reality device that [[George Lucas]] wanted to illustrate Wookiees' positive outlook on life.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|kershed|status/1461140680810668035|[[Paul Duncan]]|archivedate=20211119232625}}</ref>

According to some of [[Brian Bartholomew]]'s blueprints for various props in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' released on its 30th anniversary, the mind evaporator was made up of a purchased chair, with the "proton helmet" being made of a hairdryer connected to a plastic accordion hose (such as one belonging to a vacuum cleaner), as well as a heavy cable with sockets. The earpieces were made of clear plastic glasses or another unknown component, the latter having wheat-lamps or pilot lamps twinkling randomly (though the rest of the earpiece is opaque), three extra control knobs below the earpieces, and a socket plate on the back hood; as well as having planted-on rivets as well as enameled clear visors. The evaporator controls on the arm portions of the chair were made of a [[Wikipedia:List of Olympus products#Microcassette Voice Recorders|Pearlcorder]] that would be used to play the cassette tapes. In addition, on the back of the chair were various plastic model kits and dummy doors, as well as a vent and planted-on clear plastic multimeter measurements by Olson Electronics.<ref name="Concept art">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/photos/art.htm|text=Star Wars Holiday Special|work=The Star Wars Holiday Special|archivedate=20171227030028}}</ref>

Proton chairs appeared as decorations for player's house in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Proton chairs were added to the game with the release of the revamped [[W:c:swg:Life Day|Life Day]] event in [[December]] [[2008]]. The chairs were typical Life Day rewards, available during all Life Day events from 2008 to the closure of the game.<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68147&month=122008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed}}</ref><ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – What is Wookiee Life Day?">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68542&month=122009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; What is Wookiee Life Day?}}</ref><ref name="SonyCite-Weekly Feature – Wookiee Life Day">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69009&month=122010|text=Weekly Feature &ndash; Wookiee Life Day}}</ref> When a player sat on a proton chair in their house, they could hear a female voice speaking calm and reassuring sentences.<ref name="SWG:PC" />
